$comment: The host manifest. typedstandards-host build writes the served tree from it; every path is relative to this file. npm run ask appends one entry per record.

registry.$comment: Openmaxxing's own statement about the signing key of the records this host serves. The key is a pseudonymous did:key whose seed is kept in the author's secret store. index.$comment: The records this host serves: one per run of npm run ask that was committed.
